_meta.schema_note: one field added beyond the Obadiah v3 test's shape: 'data_anomalies' alongside t2_flags/t3_flags. This extract shows a recurring pattern -- several spans carry a person/number/possessive suffix that does not match either the surface English word or the surrounding grammar (e.g. a 1cs 'my' suffix landing on 'lack'/'wood' where 'my people' is clearly meant; 'they'/'their' surfaces sitting on tagged 3ms/3fs singular suffixes). These are recorded as their own category rather than folded into t3_flags, since they read as tokenization/tagging artifacts in this specific extract, not genuine grammatical ambiguity in the underlying Hebrew.

t1_t5.reading: Hear (H8085G[bf], Qal impv 2mp) the word (H1697G[bf]) of the Lord (H3068G[v]), O children (H1121G[bf]) of Israel (H3478[v]), for the Lord (H3068G[v]) has a controversy (H7379[v]+H3588A[v]) with the inhabitants (H3427[v], Qal act ptc mpc + H5973A[v]) of the land (H0776G[bf]+H9009[v]); there is no (H0369[v]) faithfulness (H0571G[bf]+H3588A[v]) or steadfast love (H2617A[bf]+H0369[v]+H9002[v]), and no (H0369[v]) knowledge (H1847[v]+H9002[v]) of God (H0430G[bf]) in the land (H0776G[bf]+H9009[v]).

t2_flags.note: H8085's own range extends to 'to hear, obey' -- in a covenant-lawsuit summons ('Hear'), the operative sense may be 'heed/obey', a sense stated in the word's own range, not merely 'perceive by ear'
H7379 (riv) range is explicitly a legal/technical term: 'strife, controversy, dispute; case at law' -- a covenant-lawsuit term, not casual disagreement
H1847 (da'at) range extends to 'discernment, understanding, wisdom' -- broader than bare factual knowing

t3_flags.note: H3427 tagged HVqrmpc -- Qal active participle, masculine plural construct ('those dwelling') -- durative/ongoing, not a punctual past act

t5_genre_absences: classic covenant-lawsuit (rib) form conventionally summons witnesses (e.g. 'heaven and earth', cf. Deut.32.1, Isa.1.2, Mic.6.1-2) -- no witness-summons formula accompanies the LORD's stated riv (H7379) here

t1_t5.reading: Swearing (H0422[v], Qal inf. absolute), lying (H3584[v], Piel inf. construct), murder (H7523[v], Qal inf. absolute), stealing (H1589[v], Qal inf. absolute), and committing adultery (H5003[v], Qal inf. absolute); they break all bounds (H6555[v], Qal perfect 3cp) and bloodshed (H1818[v]+H9002[v]) follows (H5060[v], Qal perfect 3cp) bloodshed (H1818[v]+H9003[v]).

t3_flags.note: five successive infinitive-absolute/infinitive-construct forms list the offenses as bare, unconjugated actions -- a distinct Hebrew stylistic device (a chain of infinitives functioning almost as a naming-list of sins), not ordinary finite-verb clauses; only 'break' (span 5) and 'follows' (span 7) are finite (Qal perfect 3cp)

t1_t5.reading: Therefore (H5921A[bf]+H3651C[v]) the land (H0776G[bf]+H9009[v]) mourns (H0056[v], Qal impf 3fs), and all (H3605[v]) who dwell (H3427[v], Qal act ptc msa) in it languish (H0535[v], morph HVPq3ms -- a passive/stative form: its own range gives '(Qal) pass participle... to be weak; (Pulal) to be or grow feeble', i.e. a condition suffered, not an act performed), and also the beasts (H2416C[v]+H9003[v]x2+H9034[v]) of the field (H7704G[v]+H9009[v]) and the birds (H5775[v]+H9002[v]+H9003[v]) of the heavens (H8064[v]+H9009[v]), and even the fish (H1709H[v]+H1571[v]+H9002[v]) of the sea (H3220G[v]+H9009[v]) are taken away (H0622[v], Niphal impf 3mp, passive).

t3_flags.note: H0622 Niphal imperfect 3mp -- explicitly passive, 'are gathered/removed'; the creatures are acted upon, not acting

t1_t5.reading: Yet (H0389[v]) let no one (H0408[v]+H0376I[v]) contend (H7378[v], Qal jussive 3ms), and let none (H0376I[v]) accuse (H3198[v], Hiphil jussive 3ms+H0408[v]+H9002[v]), for with you (H5971A[bf]+H9002[v]) is my contention (H7378[v]+H9004[v]+H9021[v]), O priest (H3548[v]).

open_naming_gaps.note: not resolved from this row alone whether a single figure or the priesthood generically is meant -- flagged for follow-up given the priest-material continuing through vv5-9

t2_flags.note: surface gloss 'with you' is tagged to H5971A, whose own lexical range is exclusively 'nation, people; persons, members of one's people' -- no 'with' sense appears anywhere in H5971A's range. Read from the row rather than the gloss (T1): this looks like a code/tokenization mismatch (Heb. 'im-'with' vs. 'am-'people' are orthographically close), not a resolved sense of 'people' meaning 'with'. This also touches a known text-critical crux in this verse (translations diverge, some reading 'for your people are like those who contend with the priest'); the row itself does not adjudicate this, and is recorded as found, not corrected.

t3_flags.note: both instances of 'stumble' share the identical lexeme+morph shape (HVqq2ms/HVqq3ms). This extract's own morph-code key isn't spelled out in the raw data, so the second aspect-letter ('q', distinct from the 'p'=perfect seen elsewhere) is read functionally -- a perfect-plus-vav form carrying forward continuing/future force -- rather than asserted as a confirmed decode

referent_cruxes.adopted: reading 2 (per-row) -- grounded directly in H9030 on 'glory' and H9028 on 'shame'; T1 requires working from the row's own data, and here the divergence is a suffix-level fact, not an inference
